skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Casual
skins.content: Cambrian 1097 Winter New Arrivals/Casual. Rainproof, wear-resistant, close-fitting yet breathing, the first choice for fashionable youth. Coloring of the lining and some accessories can be changed at the client's request, letting their no-imitation individuality pop.
skins.quote: Should ego not be manifest, it will vanish unto the masses.

skins.name: Dangerous Invitation
skins.content: Unveiling of Devotion Series New Arrivals/Dangerous Invitation. A graceful custom-made suit just for Arene. The stiff material is painstakingly cut to fit his youthful figure. He also personally selected the accompanying perfume.
skins.quote: The film has ended, and the night has just begun. The lingering fragrance on his fingertips discloses a most dangerous signal, but it is clear that he has left no room to refuse.
